theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose between light and dark appearance

language.label: Language
language.description: Select the display language for the application

autoExclude.label: Auto-exclude on deploy
autoExclude.description: Automatically add the file to .git/info/exclude when creating a deployment. If disabled, you can add it manually later from the deployment card.

tags.label: Manage tags
tags.description: View and delete tags. Tags in use by files will remain assigned until removed manually.

appData.label: Application data
appData.description: Location where the application stores its database and file versions
appData.cloudSyncWarning: This location is inside a cloud-synced folder (Synology Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive). The sync client modifies the database files while the application is using them, which causes intermittent "disk I/O error" failures when creating deployments, commits or snapshots. Move the data to a local folder.

changeDialog.title: Change data location
changeDialog.modeKeepHint: Use the data already present at this location
changeDialog.modeTransferHint: Copy your current database and files to this location
changeDialog.modeFreshHint: Begin with an empty database and no files
changeDialog.existingDataDetected: Existing application data detected at this location
changeDialog.restartWarning: The application will restart to apply the change

snapshots.label: Automatic snapshots
snapshots.description: Automatically save a snapshot every time a managed file changes. Snapshots are saved between commits and can be browsed in the history timeline.

logs.label: Application log
logs.description: See what the application is doing internally: git operations, deployments and any error, with its real cause.
logs.title: Application log
logs.verboseHint: Also record every internal operation (debug level). Useful to reproduce a problem; makes the log grow faster.
logs.limitHint: How many entries to read from the end of the log file

export.label: Export data
export.description: Export all application data to a backup file
export.error: An error occurred while exporting data

import.label: Import data
import.description: Import application data from a backup file
import.error: An error occurred while importing data
import.confirm: Are you sure you want to import this data? Existing data will be replaced.

update.checkError: Could not check for updates. Click to retry.

channel.label: Channel
channel.betaHint: Release candidates before they go stable.
channel.devHint: Test builds published from a pull request. May be unstable.

webServer.label: Web access
webServer.description: Serve the application over HTTP so you can use it from a browser on another machine. Everything runs on this computer; the browser is only the interface.
webServer.bindAll: Allow access from other machines on the network
webServer.networkWarning: The server accepts connections from the network. Anyone with the token can read and write files and run git on this machine — use it only on networks you trust, or over a VPN.
webServer.tokenHint: Enter this token the first time you open the address in a browser. You can also type your own: at least {{min}} characters, no spaces. Changing or regenerating it signs out every open session.
webServer.tokenInvalid: The token must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters, with no spaces.
webServer.copyError: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.
webServer.desktopOnly: The server can only be started, stopped or reconfigured from the desktop window: doing it from here would cut off your own connection.
